digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler with Jira Data Center instance
propositions: rebar must be proven to reconcile bidirectionally against a real Jira Data Center instance using a copy of the project's actual ticket store, not an empty one
isolation must be enforced by hard separation (no git remote, orphan tickets branch materialized separately) plus configuration validation, not by flags that can be overridden
the copied store must have all Jira IDs and reconciler artifacts scrubbed (.bridge_state* directories and bindings), verified structurally not by enumerated lists

a comprehensive mutation table (28 cells covering create/update/delete/link/parent/label/status/assignee operations in both directions) must each assert round-trip individually via named oracles on both local and remote
inbound and outbound passes must converge to zero new mutations on a second pass, proving idempotence
pagination must be measured live (effective page size observed), seeded to force multiple pages, and fully recovered despite eventual consistency
